sections.Profile:
The "Independence Day" pinball machine, released by Sega in July 1996, is themed after the blockbuster movie and features a combination of sci-fi and action elements. Designed by Rob Hurtado, with artwork by Jeff Busch, the machine includes three flippers, three ramps, and four multiball modes, including the unique Alien Head and Area 51 multiballs.
